summary: Short kerb on a busy road beside a car park, signed No Stopping.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs cover it
Main road kerb, no parking lane
Only 15 m, beside a car park entrance

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings nearby; bush on the north side and a customer car park and tennis courts around.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb sits against bush with no shoulder; the car park entrance is 7 m along and is signed customers only.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a marked median; noise from passing traffic.
drivers.convention: A van or car is parked on the far side, but not along this kerb, and signs forbid stopping.

flags: No Stopping Any Time at 0.1 m and 12.3 m along the kerb line
Low-lying: about 3.2 m elevation, Witton Creek 39 m away
sun_shade: Tree canopy to the north and west of the kerb; open to the south.
